name: CodeUltraFeedback
description: A dataset and evaluation framework for assessing and improving large language models' alignment with user-defined coding preferences, consisting of 10,000 coding instructions with multiple LLM-generated responses annotated by GPT-3.5 as a judge.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for coding preference alignment that is gaining attention in LLM code-evaluation research but is not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Includes annotations across five coding preferences and supports fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for alignment.
